what.title: Learn the break-in to learn the lock
what.lede: SQL Heist is an educational SQL-injection game. You pull the attack against a real database, then study the code that should have stopped you — offence teaches defence better than any lecture.

0.v: 100% in your browser. Nothing ever touches the network.

1.v: A real SQLite engine, seeded fresh for every single run.

2.v: No real target — the only thing you can break is the sandbox.

1.title: Recon

2.title: Exploit

0.a: Yes. Every job runs entirely in your browser against a sandboxed SQLite database that ships with the game. No real systems, no network calls — nothing to break but the practice target.

1.q: Do I need to install anything?
1.a: No. It runs in a modern browser. The SQLite engine loads on demand the first time you need it — no accounts, no downloads, no setup.

2.q: Do I need to know SQL already?
2.a: It helps. The game assumes you can read a SELECT and roughly follow a WHERE clause. It teaches you injection — not SQL from zero.

3.q: Are you teaching people to attack real websites?
3.a: We teach how injection works so you can recognise it and close it — every job ends with the fix, not the break-in. Use it only on systems you own or are allowed to test.
